name: SuQing's Search Enhancement
description: Search carried items and listed, accessible, explored nearby containers. Supports names, @mod, ASCII case-insensitive exact &Full.ID, whitespace AND, exclusions, OR and quoted groups. The sandbox handling mode defaults to all searches; special-only mode retains existing matching and yellow highlights for ordinary field input. The F8 panel always enhances searches. Enhanced matches have purple outlines and original yellow search highlights; selection/hover retain their backgrounds. Matching groups stay first across filter/sort refreshes; clearing restores native order. Priority resumes after dragging ends without another item click. Detailed lists are adapted; icon grids are not. Optional pinyin depends on an enabled upstream provider and dictionary. Eight personal Mod Options remain separate from the sandbox mode; context entry and click popup default off. No external hard prerequisite. Targets B42.21 single-player. Search scans run across frames and reuse text and pinyin results. Matching stacks stay first when expanded or collapsed in CleanUI.
